evidence_excerpts: Their first psychedelic experience ... significant changes found at 4 weeks (t(52) = 3.85, p = 0.001, d = 0.53, 95% CI [0.21, 0.66]) and 6 months (t(52) = 5.32, p < 0.0001, d = 0.73, 95% CI [0.36, 0.80]).
text: Participants with no prior psychedelic experience showed larger shifts away from physicalism than the full observational sample.
